security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A fast, focused text editor with a Rust file engine
bundle.longDescription: A free, open-source text editor from GoodApps. Sublime-inspired simplicity, keyboard-first editing, and bounded section reads for multi-GB UTF-8 files. Built with Rust, Tauri, and CodeMirror.
